name: Ecclesiastes
lede: The twenty-first book of the Bible, in full: the words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem — vanity of vanities, a time to every purpose under heaven, two are better than one, a good name, and remember also thy Creator in the days of thy youth — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Vanity of Vanities
books.blurb: The words of the Preacher: vanity of vanities, all is vanity; the sun ariseth and goeth down, the wind turneth about, all the rivers run into the sea, and there is no new thing under the sun; his great works, his houses and pools and singers, and all a striving after wind; and for everything there is a season — a time to be born, and a time to die.

books.name: Two Are Better than One
books.blurb: The tears of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; better is a handful with quietness; one that is alone, and he hath not a second; two are better than one, and a threefold cord is not quickly broken; keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God — let thy words be few; the sleep of a laboring man is sweet; naked shall he go again as he came; and his days as a shadow.

books.name: A Good Name
books.blurb: A good name is better than precious oil; the house of mourning and the crackling of thorns under a pot; consider the work of God; one man among a thousand have I found; keep the king's command; a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine; a living dog is better than a dead lion; whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; the race is not to the swift; and the little city and the poor wise man.

books.name: Remember Thy Creator
books.blurb: Dead flies in the perfumer's oil; he that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice; cast thy bread upon the waters; truly the light is sweet; rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; then remember also thy Creator — before the silver cord is loosed, or the golden bowl is broken, and the dust returneth to the earth; and the end of the matter: fear God, and keep his commandments.
